scope: Bounded offline static design review. No implementation or workflow state changes.

findings.summary: Dependency changes and one fixed-version download await human authorization; BZIP2 writer source and license remain unavailable. This is an external gate, not a design defect.
Define archive root mapping, colliding input basenames, normalized duplicate entries and ancestor/type conflicts before output.
Complete format/encoding matrix, including GZIP Latin-1 header restrictions, plain stream output naming and TAR legacy-byte versus PAX behavior.
Finalize staging limits or explicit no-fixed-limit policy, full checksum preflight for stdout, disk-full behavior and ownership-limited cleanup.
Define pack output inside source-tree handling, overlapping inputs and source identity recheck before delete to avoid self-inclusion or deleting replaced sources.
Clarify mixed/repeated stdin and -c/-o conflict, link-chain ordering and binary lookup failure behavior in the existing Work Items.

validation.method: Local source and documentation reading only
